content: <1>Folders ({{foldersCount}})</1> will be moved to Trash, where you can restore them for 30 days. After that, they're permanently deleted.

comment.text: Body text of the Move to Trash? confirmation dialog shown when a user deletes several folders. {{foldersCount}} is the number of folders and <1></1> makes the count in bold; Trash is the name of the Trash section; they stay restorable for 30 days, after which they are deleted automatically.
